verdict.rationale: An official Raygun MCP server is documented, so an agent has a first-party path to error data. Raygun captures full stack traces, ranks errors by users affected and occurrences, and offers an error-status triage workflow. However, the evidence gives no detail on what the MCP server exposes, the probes found no public OpenAPI spec, and nothing shows filing bugs into an issue tracker (GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab are cited only as repo/source-map integrations). Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for listing top issues with stack traces, documented API access to error groups, issue-tracker bug-filing integration, hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my top production issues with stack traces via API or MCP, triage them, and file the real bugs into my tracker

citations.quote: Raygun automatically captures detailed diagnostics for each and every error occurrence including full stack traces
Order and prioritize errors based on users affected and the number of occurrences
Error statuses provides a workflow for triaging and managing your error inbox in Crash Reporting.
